metadata.title: Application Core

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for operating applications as intentional, accountable units of institutional logic.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Executable application services, web applications, APIs, background workers, and internal services implementing business logic.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Pattern establishing baseline trust assumptions for applications as decision-making systems.

metadata.remarks: Application Core defines the foundational trust properties required to treat an application as a legitimate, intentional, and governable system. This pattern establishes ownership, purpose, lifecycle awareness, and accountability, without addressing authorization logic, input handling, or data access.

components.title: Application Identity and Ownership
components.description: Defines clear ownership and identity for the application as an accountable institutional asset.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Masquerading as a legitimate application or service.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Strong identity binding for application-level actors.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Applications have defined ownership and documented purpose.
Identity attributes uniquely identify the application and its role.

components.title: Application Purpose and Intent Definition
components.description: Ensures each application has a defined and understood purpose that constrains its behavior.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Abuse of trusted application behavior to perform unintended actions.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Policy enforcement aligning execution with stated application purpose.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Policies define and constrain the intended purpose of applications.

components.title: Application Lifecycle Awareness
components.description: Manages creation, change, and retirement of applications to prevent residual risk.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Persistence through deprecated or unmanaged applications.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Lifecycle controls to retire or restrict obsolete applications.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Unnecessary or obsolete application functionality is removed or disabled.

components.title: Application Accountability and Observability
components.description: Provides traceability of application execution and decisions.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Suppression of evidence related to application behavior.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Audit logging to support investigation of application actions.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Application execution and decision points are logged.
Audit review supports oversight and accountability of application behavior.
